name: Monterey Bay Aquarium
tagline: Jellies first, then southern sea otters and the Kelp Forest — Magellanic penguins are not a Start here.

practical.transit_note: Cannery Row; walkable from nearby hotels.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Monterey bonus · jellies + sea otters + Kelp Forest

challenges.text: Jellies: watch one pulse from top to bottom.
Sea otter: snack on the belly or a back float?
Kelp Forest: count the fish you can see in one glance.
Giant Pacific octopus: how long until you spot an arm?
